reason: I am paying for my family's system from abroad and I cannot see the shop or the installer myself, so written offers with brand and model plus photos of the labels before handover is exactly what I need. Sending one request costs me nothing, so I will try it once and judge by what comes back.
objection: I worry the app is empty and no real companies will reply, and that a photo of a label does not prove the battery is new or genuine. Who is SunXFinder, and what happens if the company ignores my problem report?
would_change_my_mind: If my first request gets no real written offers within 48 hours, or the phone-call fallback just gives me vague names, I would not use it again.
